summary.text: Ryan Zinke represents Montana's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House; first elected in 2014, he served as U.S. Secretary of the Interior between noncontiguous House terms.

paragraphs.text: He served 23 years in the U.S. Navy, including with the Navy SEALs, retiring in 2008, and was later elected to the Montana State Senate.
Zinke was born in Bozeman, lives in Whitefish, and holds a B.S. in geology from the University of Oregon.
